result.finding: Minimal security implementation. No authentication, authorization, HTTPS/TLS, or encryption configured. The application is publicly accessible with no access controls. File upload validation (MIME type and size) is the only security control. Passwords are hardcoded in docker-compose.yml.
evidence: pom.xml: spring-boot-starter-security is NOT in dependencies
No @EnableWebSecurity, @PreAuthorize, JWT, or OAuth2 annotations found in source code
application.properties: no server.ssl.* configuration (HTTP only, port 8080)
No encryption libraries or AES/RSA usage in source code
docker-compose.yml: passwords hardcoded in plaintext (ORACLE_PASSWORD, SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD)
HomeController: file upload validation for MIME type (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp) and size (10MB max)
No CORS, CSP, HSTS, or X-Frame-Options header configuration found
values: File upload validation: MIME type whitelist + 10MB size limit
